title: Nepal Police Cyber Bureau Impersonation Scam Ring (RING-02)

claims.text: A ring of 49 victims across seven districts lost NPR 33,880,600 between February and August 2026 to callers impersonating Nepal Police Cyber Bureau officers who threatened "digital arrest" unless victims paid a "refundable verification deposit" to specified bank accounts or eSewa wallets. The operation uses a consistent set of phone numbers, bank accounts, wallet IDs, and officer aliases across 49 complaints.

claims.reason: number 2,026 is not in the cited evidence

claims.text: Caller impersonates a Nepal Police Cyber Bureau officer (e.g., "Officer Shrestha", "Officer Sharma", "Officer Rajesh Thapa") and claims the victim's citizenship ID was misused to open fraudulent bank accounts.
claims.reason: Evidence shows callers impersonate officers and claim citizenship ID misuse.

claims.text: Caller threatens imminent "digital arrest", court case, or asset freeze, and explicitly forbids the victim from telling family members (phrases such as "garidina parivar lai", "parivar lai na bhanus", "dherai jaldi garna parchha").
claims.reason: Evidence includes threats of digital arrest/court and phrases forbidding family disclosure.

claims.text: Caller demands a "verification deposit" or "refundable verification deposit" to clear the victim's name, claiming it will be returned after investigation.
claims.reason: Evidence shows callers demand verification/refundable deposit to clear name.

claims.text: Caller provides specific bank account details (Trelisa Bikas Bank a/c 1654051531952058 held by Sagar G.; Trelisa Bikas Bank a/c 4246095396218518 held by Bikash R.; Ovanta Bank a/c 9986143410369711 held by Rekha S.) or eSewa wallet IDs (964555220, 964555120) for immediate transfer via mobile banking or eSewa.
claims.reason: Evidence lists specific bank accounts and eSewa wallet IDs used for transfers.

claims.text: Caller instructs payment from specific phone numbers (e.g., 973555395, 965555229, 962555039, 965555953, 965555810, 977555712, 970555946, 976555008) and pressures immediate transfer; after payment the caller stops responding.
claims.reason: Evidence cites caller numbers and notes calls cease after payment.

claims.text: Victim transfers amounts ranging from NPR 464,000 to NPR 1,084,500 (median NPR 688,500) and later realizes the police impersonation was a scam.
claims.reason: Evidence provides transfer amounts and F2 gives median/range.
